regioni.registro: Registro de Turismo de la Comunitat Valenciana
regioni.annunci_testo: Valencian law requires holiday homes to show their exact location and their Registro de Turismo number in all advertising (Ley 15/2018, art. 19.1 b).
punti: Only whole homes can be let as viviendas de uso turístico, for stays of up to 10 days in a row with the same guest; letting rooms to tourists is prohibited (art. 65.1 and 65.3).
cv_ley

The home needs a favourable municipal report on urban-planning compatibility for tourist use (informe municipal de compatibilidad urbanística) and, where required, the municipal permits for that use (art. 65.1).
cv_ley
The cadastral reference of the home must appear in the declaration to the register and in the letting contracts (art. 65.1).
cv_ley
Registration of a tourist home on the Registro de Turismo is valid for 5 years, with the exceptions set in the law and its implementing decree (art. 65.4).
cv_ley
Article 65 was amended by Decreto-ley 9/2024 of 2 August (note in the consolidated text on BOE).
cv_ley
verifica: Generalitat Valenciana open data: the list of registered tourist homes, updated daily, with each CV-VUT number
regioni.risposta: To let a home to tourists in the Valencian Community you must declare it to the regional tourism administration and have it on the Registro de Turismo de la Comunitat Valenciana, with a favourable municipal planning report (Ley 15/2018, arts. 19 and 65

regioni.annunci_testo: Andalusian rules require the home's alphanumeric RTA code on the document given to every guest on arrival (Decreto 28/2016, art. 7.1), and tourism businesses must make their RTA registration details available to guests (Ley 13/2011, art. 26.1 b). The texts we read do not set a separate rule on adverts.
punti: Before starting, the host files an electronic declaración responsable with the regional tourism department; from that moment the home may be advertised as a vivienda de uso turístico (Decreto 28/2016, art. 9.1).
and_decreto
The declaration states that the home is compatible with local urban planning and has, where required, the licence or declaration for change of use (art. 9.1 e).
and_decreto
It also states that the community of owners does not prohibit tourist use and has expressly authorised it in the terms required by state law (art. 9.1 g).
and_decreto
Town halls may set limits on the maximum number of tourist homes per building, sector, area or zone, for an overriding reason of general interest (art. 2.2).
and_decreto
Only one home per cadastral reference can be registered, except where several homes legally share one (art. 9.1 a).
and_decreto
Registration on the RTA is done on the basis of the declaration, and filing it is enough to start the activity (Ley 13/2011, art. 38.2).
and_ley
verifica: Junta de Andalucía: OPEN RTA search (filter by activity 'viviendas de uso turístico')
regioni.risposta: To let a home to tourists in Andalusia you must file an electronic declaración responsable, which puts the home on the Registro de Turismo de Andalucía (Decreto 28/2016, art. 9, and Ley 13/2011, art. 38

regioni.numero: HUTB-…, HUTG-…, HUTT-…, HUTL-… (Barcelona, Girona, Tarragona, Lleida)
regioni.annunci_testo: Catalan law requires the Registre de Turisme number of tourist accommodation in all advertising, promotion and marketing (Ley 13/2002, art. 73.5).
punti: Tourist homes (habitatges d'ús turístic, HUT) are let whole, never by the room, and need the enabling title required by law before they are offered, marketed or advertised (Ley 13/2002, art. 50 bis).
cat_ley

In the 262 municipalities listed in Decreto-ley 3/2023 (among them Barcelona, Salou, Sitges, Lloret de Mar, Cambrils, Girona and Tarragona), tourist use of a home needs a prior urban-planning licence, valid for five years (art. 1 and annex).
cat_dl

Tourist homes already authorised in those municipalities on 9 November 2023 must obtain that licence within five years or stop the activity; the holder can ask the town hall once for an extension of up to five more years (transitional provision 2).
cat_dl
verifica: Generalitat de Catalunya open data: the Registre de Turisme de Catalunya list, with each HUT number
regioni.risposta: To let a home to tourists in Catalonia you need the enabling title and a number on the Registre de Turisme de Catalunya, plus an urban-planning licence in 262 municipalities (Ley 13/2002, arts. 50 bis and 73, and Decreto-ley 3/2023

regioni.registro: insular tourism registers (Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza, Formentera)
regioni.annunci_testo: All advertising of holiday homes must include the home's tourist registration number (Ley 8/2012, art. 28.3); advertising or marketing stays without it is a very serious offence for the channels that publish it (art. 120 j).
punti: The host files a declaración responsable de inicio de actividad turística (DRIAT); filing it leads to immediate registration in the island's register (Ley 8/2012, art. 23.6).
bal_ley
Until the number is issued, the entry number of the DRIAT in a public register may be used in adverts (art. 23.7).
bal_ley
New DRIATs for tourist stays in homes can only be filed for homes in zones expressly declared suitable (zonas aptas) (art. 50.3).
bal_ley
For homes in buildings under horizontal property, the DRIAT is valid for the period set by regulation, five years by default, renewable while the requirements are still met (art. 50.3).
bal_ley
regioni.risposta: To let a home to tourists in the Balearic Islands you must file a DRIAT, which puts the home on the island's tourism register, and new homes are only allowed in zones declared suitable (Ley 8/2012, arts. 23 and 50

regioni.registro: Registro General Turístico de Canarias (through the island Cabildo)
regioni.numero: registration number on the Registro General Turístico
regioni.annunci_testo: The registration on the Registro General Turístico contains a registration number that must be included in any advert or listing of the home, on platforms or elsewhere (Ley 6/2025, art. 8.6); advertising without it is a very serious offence (Ley 7/1995, art. 75.16).
punti: Ley 6/2025 on the sustainable tourist use of homes came into force on 13 December 2025 (BOE consolidated text).
can_ley
The host files a declaración responsable with all required documents; the activity may start on the day of filing, and the island Cabildo registers it on the Registro General Turístico (art. 8.1).
can_ley
Registration does not validate the activity: the Cabildo and the Government of the Canary Islands keep their powers to check, inspect and sanction (art. 8.2).
can_ley
regioni.risposta: To let a home to tourists in the Canary Islands you must file a declaración responsable with the island Cabildo, which registers the home on the Registro General Turístico with a registration number (Ley 6/2025, art. 8

regioni.registro: Registro de Empresas Turísticas de la Comunidad de Madrid
regioni.annunci_testo: The 2014 rule that required the register number in every advert (Decreto 79/2014, art. 17.5) was annulled by the Supreme Court in judgment 1741/2018, as the preamble of Decreto 29/2019 states; the new art. 17 does not contain it.
punti: Owners of tourist homes (or their representatives) must file a declaración responsable with the regional tourism department, together with the CIVUT, the certificate of suitability for tourist use (Decreto 79/2014, art. 17.1 as amended in 2019).
mad_decreto2019

After the declaration, registration on the Registro de Empresas Turísticas follows art. 23 of Ley 1/1999 (art. 17.3); that article describes the register as public and registration as voluntary (Ley 1/1999, art. 23.2).
mad_ley
In buildings under horizontal property, tourist use can be limited or conditioned under the Ley de Propiedad Horizontal (art. 17.5 as amended in 2019).
mad_decreto2019
The 2016 regional court judgment 302/2016 annulled the 5-night minimum of the original decree (preamble of Decreto 29/2019).
mad_decreto2019
regioni.risposta: To let a home to tourists in the Community of Madrid you must file a declaración responsable, together with the CIVUT certificate of suitability, with the regional tourism department (Decreto 79/2014, art. 17, as amended by Decreto 29/2019
